title: 2.3 Solving Inequalities Using Multiplication or Division

icans: I can solve inequalities by multiplying or dividing by a positive number.
I can solve inequalities by multiplying or dividing by a negative number.
I can write and solve inequalities for real-life problems.

vocab: Multiplying or dividing by a positive number
Multiplying or dividing by a negative number

blocks.p: Start with the true statement 4 < 6. Do the same thing to both sides.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Positive numbers: Multiply or divide by a positive number: _______________ the symbol.
Negative numbers: Multiply or divide by a negative number: _______________ the symbol.
